name: skin_maple_1
prompt: Image 1 is a crop of a photoreal audio-plugin UI showing a pedal steel guitar. Image 2 shows another pedal steel design. Output ONE image, landscape 1536x1024, that is image 1 with ONLY the instrument's BODY (cabinet, apron, end caps, trim and legs) restyled after image 2: figured birdseye maple (warm natural blond, matte satin lacquer), with image 2's body shape, end caps and legs. EXACTLY the same camera, framing, scale, perspective, room, rug and lighting as image 1, so it overlays image 1 pixel for pixel. The body's top edge, front rail and outline stay where image 1 has them. No text, letters, badges or nameplates anywhere. It must look like a real photographed instrument with honest wear.
